items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Well, his brother was Lorenzo. Lorenzo was one of them.

ctx.x: Do you remember who else played in the orchestra, the other clarinetists?
Louie Teo. Well, his brother was Lorenzo. Lorenzo was one of them. I don't remember the others.
Do you remember Alphonse Piku ever played? Who? Alphonse Piku.
